competitors.title: PDE 13 | Wave equation: separation of variables
competitors.description_excerpt: An introduction to PDEs. Topics: idea of separation of variables, separation of variables for the wave equation (3:58), summary (16:46). Part of a full PDE playlist.

competitors.title: Solving the 1-D Heat/Diffusion PDE by Separation of Variables (Part 1/2)
competitors.description_excerpt: Introduces separation of variables to solve an initial-boundary value problem with the 1-D heat equation and homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. Includes lecture notes and Patreon support.

competitors.title: PDE 101: Separation of Variables! ...or how I learned to stop worrying and solve Laplace's equation
competitors.description_excerpt: Introduces separation of variables to solve Laplace's equation in 2D for steady state heat distribution on a rectangle. Covers linear superposition, reducing PDEs to ODEs, and Fourier transform. Well-structured with chapter timestamps.
